title: Fetch text attachments in the background
notes: core/crates/engine/tests/engine_attach_fetch.rs, 8 tests over the scripted IMAP server of body-r2 on 127.0.0.1 (header line 2; the account's hosts are 127.0.0.1 at :43 and the adapter's at :63 with Security::PlainLoopbackOnly; proof 1 greps every host line of the file): :144 a_mail_with_a_pdf_and_a_text_file_gets_both_fetched_and_cut_with_no_command (PDF and plain text fetched after the mail is stored, no click, their text read and cut into chunk rows), :163 a_picture_is_not_fetched, :181 a_file_over_the_size_limit_is_not_fetched (10 MiB + 1; the limit is attachment_auto.rs:121 within_size, ATTACH_AUTO_FETCH_MAX_BYTES), :199 a_file_already_on_disk_is_not_fetched_again, :232 a_failing_fetch_leaves_one_log_line_and_the_queue_goes_on, :266 the_backfill_fetches_stored_mail_newest_first, :287 the_queue_yields_after_the_per_step_bound (bounded per step, ATTACH_AUTO_FETCH_PER_STEP), :304 at_the_total_cap_nothing_more_is_fetched_and_one_line_says_so. The broken copies are those in each test's doc comment (and docs/lanes/attach-fetch.md 'Broken copy per test'); every find was checked to occur once. NOT given: the size-limit copy (test :181), because the doc comment says it needs two edits (within_size and the SQL bound at attachment_auto.rs:239); a single-line copy of either leaves the other bound in force and the test green. Caution for the lead: docs/lanes/attach-fetch.md 'What could not be settled' says engine_attachments.rs and engine_body_r3.rs go red with this lane on unless run with WHOOSH_ATTACH_AUTO_FETCH=off; that is outside this finish line. Nothing was run by me.
